node.label: Xanthomas of the palmar creases
node.definition: The presence of multiple xanthomas (xanthomata) in the skin distributed in the creases of the palm of the hand. Xanthomas are yellowish, firm, lipid-laden nodules in the skin.

evidence.snippet: Dysbetalipoproteinemia: Xanthomas of the palmar creases (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
Xanthomas of the palmar creases — Frequent (79-30%)
